name: First-pass Lisa decide(needs_clarification) → coordinator ask_user (inherit anchor)
description:
ADR-044 §addendum Slice 6 (go-reviewer R2) — routes a FIRST-PASS planner escalation to the user. First-pass Lisa (dev-via-test-plan spawned by rule 01) may emit decide(needs_clarification) when the user's ask can't be turned into a faithful plan without clarification. Before Slice 6 no rule caught role=dev-via-test-plan + next_action=needs_clarification, so it silently dead-ended the chain. Slice 6 actively prompts it (Lisa's emit-contract tells her to use it on an impossible finding), so the route is load-bearing.

ADR-053 Phase 4b-1a anchor split: this rule is now fenced to FIRST-PASS Lisa (lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_eq 0). First-pass Lisa is spawned by rule 01 with run_scope=new, so it carries a bare agent.run triple (graph_writer.go:535-539) and the coordinator this rule spawns INHERITS agent.run.entity_id down the loop-spawn chain — so an involuntary failure of that woken coordinator routes to agent-run/05 (anchor_inherit, no thread). The RE-PLAN Lisa (spawned from the run entity by rule 02d, carries lineage.run-loop-entity-id but NO bare agent.run) is the sibling rule 02f-replan, which must thread the anchor explicitly. Same first-pass/re-plan anchor split as rules 02 vs 02g and 09 vs 10.

Mirrors the research needs-clarification-replan pattern (also anchor_inherit), scoped to first-pass Lisa. Spawns a coordinator wake-up scoped to ask_user; the user clarifies and a fresh chain fires on their reply.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
The dev-via-test planner (Lisa) at loop $entity.instance could not turn the user's request into a faithful plan and emitted needs_clarification.

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result(loop_id=$entity.instance) to read Lisa's reason — what's blocking (ambiguous ask, contradictory requirements, missing detail).

Iteration 2 — call decide(action="ask_user", reason="<surface Lisa's blocker to the user as a plain-English question; ask for the specific clarification she needs>"). One question, addressed to the user, no internal jargon. The user replies and a fresh coordinator loop fires on their answer.

metadata.phase: ADR-044 §addendum Slice 6 — planner needs_clarification route (go-reviewer R2); ADR-053 Phase 4b-1a anchor split
metadata.review_origin: go-reviewer R2 (2026-06-05): Lisa's needs_clarification (rule 01 + 02d allowlists) had no routing rule → silent chain dead-end. Slice 6 promotes it from unlikely to prompted, so this route is required.
metadata.anchor_disposition: anchor_inherit (ADR-053 Phase 4b-1a, TestAgentRunPack_CoordinatorSpawnCoverage) — first-pass Lisa carries a bare agent.run (rule 01 run_scope=new), so the spawned coordinator inherits agent.run.entity_id and a failure routes to agent-run/05. NO run-loop-entity-id thread.
metadata.split_rationale: Fenced to first-pass Lisa via lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_eq 0 (rule 01 threads only dev-via-test-run, no run-loop-entity-id). RE-PLAN Lisa (spawned from the run entity by rule 02d, carries lineage.run-loop-entity-id but NO bare agent.run) is the sibling rule 02f-replan — it must thread the anchor (anchor_threaded → rule 06). Mutually exclusive on lineage.run-loop-entity-id presence. Same first-pass/re-plan split as rules 02 vs 02g.
